judge.rationale: The candidate implemented the wrong wire protocol names (`list_sessions` and `session_list` with `sessions` instead of `list_conversations` and `conversation_list` with `conversations`) and type names (`ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionListMessage`, `SessionSummaryFrame` instead of `ListConversationsMessage`, `ConversationListMessage`, `ConversationSummary`). It completely omitted the required `HalEngineConfig.transport.history?: {enabled: boolean}` opt-in flag and the `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED` error code. Furthermore, it violated explicit ticket requirements by returning an empty list `{sessions: []}` when `store.listFor` is absent (the ticket specifically mandates returning an `UNSUPPORTED` error and never `[]`), and by allowing `limit: 0` or `limit > 200` in validation instead of enforcing 1–200. It also left an uncommitted `.lore/dod.md` artifact and missed updating `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, and `docs/getting-started.md`.
